Government Methods is a student-run initiative in the Department of Government at Georgetown University. Maintained by graduate students and supported by the Department, it gathers the tools, workflows, code, and conceptual frameworks we repeatedly return to in our research and teaching. The aim is not to create a comprehensive methods encyclopedia, but to build a shared working archive — careful, reproducible, and evolving — that strengthens how we design, implement, and communicate political science research.

**Web editor:** Parushya

---

## Methods Brown Bag

A recurring workshop series where graduate students present tools, workflows, and research design concepts — with reproducible examples in R and Quarto. Each academic year is a season.

**Organizers**

- Season 2 (2026–27): Sara Mohammadi, Sieun
- Season 1 (2025–26): Parushya, Sara Mohammadi

**Sessions and presenters**

```{=html}
<div id="gm-bb-contributors" class="gm-contributors">
  <!-- populated from chapters-meta.json, grouped by season; static fallback below if fetch fails -->
  <noscript>
    <ul>
      <li>Diana Kazarian</li>
      <li>Minha Kim</li>
      <li>Samirah Jaigirdar</li>
      <li>Rong Qin</li>
      <li>Hashem Krayem</li>
      <li>Alexander K. Rodriguez</li>
      <li>John Severini</li>
      <li>Parushya</li>
    </ul>
  </noscript>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Same-origin first (works on the live site and on a combined local
  // render), then the live copy (works under `quarto preview`).
  const BB_JSON_LOCAL = "/methodsbrownbag/chapters-meta.json";
  const BB_JSON_LIVE  = "https://govtmethods.github.io/methodsbrownbag/chapters-meta.json";
  const BB_BASE = "https://govtmethods.github.io/methodsbrownbag/";
  const FALLBACK = ["Diana Kazarian","Minha Kim","Samirah Jaigirdar","Rong Qin",
                    "Hashem Krayem","Alexander K. Rodriguez","John Severini","Parushya"];

  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
    return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]; }); }

  fetch(BB_JSON_LOCAL)
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .catch(function () { return fetch(BB_JSON_LIVE).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }); })
    .then(function (chapters) {
      // Seasons are book parts, already newest-first in the JSON. Within a
      // season, presenters are listed alphabetically with each of their sessions.
      var seasons = [];
      chapters.forEach(function (c) {
        var key = c.part || "";
        var s = seasons.find(function (x) { return x.part === key; });
        if (!s) { s = { part: key, byAuthor: {} }; seasons.push(s); }
        (c.author ? c.author.split(", ") : []).forEach(function (a) {
          a = a.trim();
          if (!a) return;
          if (!s.byAuthor[a]) s.byAuthor[a] = [];
          s.byAuthor[a].push(c);
        });
      });
      var container = document.getElementById("gm-bb-contributors");
      if (!container || seasons.length === 0) return;

      container.innerHTML = seasons.map(function (s) {
        var heading = s.part ? '<h3 class="gm-contrib-season">' + esc(s.part) + "</h3>" : "";
        var people = Object.keys(s.byAuthor).sort().map(function (author) {
          var sessions = s.byAuthor[author].map(function (c) {
            var date = c.date ? '<span class="gm-contrib-date">' + esc(c.date) + "</span>" : "";
            return '<li><a href="' + BB_BASE + esc(c.href) + '">' + esc(c.title) + "</a>" + date + "</li>";
          }).join("");
          return '<div class="gm-contributor">' +
            '<div class="gm-contrib-name">' + esc(author) + "</div>" +
            "<ul>" + sessions + "</ul></div>";
        }).join("");
        return heading + people;
      }).join("");
    })
    .catch(function () {
      var container = document.getElementById("gm-bb-contributors");
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = "<ul>" + FALLBACK.map(function (n) { return "<li>" + n + "</li>"; }).join("") + "</ul>";
    });
})();
</script>
```

## Math and Programming Camp

An intensive refresher in mathematics, statistics, and computation held at the start of the academic year. [Every edition](/mathcamp/) is published as its own site.

**Instructors**

- 2026: Parushya and Rong Qin
- 2024, 2025: Mohammad Hashem Krayem and Parushya

---

## Contributing

Sessions are written by the graduate students who present them. If you presented a session and want it on the site, [Submitting a Session](submit.html) explains what to send — no GitHub account, and nothing to install. Editors maintain the site itself; if you are joining as one, ask and we will get you set up.
